teaching.title: Introductory Programming Lab Support
bullets: Assisted introductory programming lab sessions covering debugging and functions, and answered student questions during office hours.
Graded programming exercises using an instructor-provided rubric as part of assigned teaching assistant activities.

projects.title: Command-Line Word Game
bullets: Implemented a small command-line word game using Python functions and collections for an individual undergraduate course project.
Tested example inputs and documented the program's behaviour, using Git within the course project.
